responsibility: This file implements an AArch64 RTL optimization pass for Cortex-A57 tuning that steers FMUL and FMADD/FMSUB dependency chains onto favorable floating-point pipelines by renaming registers. Reusing regrename’s def-use chain analysis, it builds forests of multiply and fused-multiply-accumulate instructions linked through accumulator dependencies, chooses a target parity for each forest based on current pipeline balance, and renames destination registers so dependent FMA chains keep matching parity while overall issue pressure is balanced between the two FPU pipelines. The pass is exposed through make_pass_fma_steering and is enabled by the corresponding extra tuning flag at higher optimization levels.
